title: Edward Condon, atomic insider turned UFO debunker

plain: The physicist Edward Condon, who studied in the German university town of Göttingen alongside the physicist Max Born and later worked on the atomic bomb at Los Alamos with J. Robert Oppenheimer and General Leslie Groves, is said to have lost his security clearance and then, in 1966, had it mysteriously restored. Jesse Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, and says Condon was then put on a panel that dealt a death blow to UFO research by calling it a waste of time and money. Michels raises it to suggest that the man who closed the door on UFOs was a trusted atomic insider.
